alex: Heads-up — after last night's runtime roll we saw a warm-priming hit-rate drop on prod for several models. Not huge but reproducible on 2 hosts.
maria: which roll? kernel scheduler change? :thinking:
alex: yeah, kernel prioritization + new attention microkernel. rolled ~22:10 UTC. metrics: prefix_cache_hit_rate down ~6% on short prompts. CL: rti/compile/2026:attn-microkernel-prio
chen: logs? p99 latency spike?
alex: p99 +40ms for first token on warm starts. overall throughput steady. attaching profiling snippet.
sam: perf-bot run? can you paste flame? 
alex: perf-bot: triggered
perf-bot: perf-run 1765433210-1: snapshot taken. diffs: kv_key_hash_ops +12%, context-lookup latency +28ms, kernel_dispatch_wait +9ms
maria: quick hypothesis: new kernel changes changed padding/strided layout leading to different prefix key canonicalization (we've seen this before)
chen: can we reproduce in staging with quantized-attn profile? I can spin up 4x p3-like.
alex: repro script (staging):
```bash
./run_workload --model redwood-open-7b --prompt-seed=42 --batch=1 --prefix="login:user"
```
alex: When I toggle old scheduler flag runtime.use_old_sched=true hit-rate recovers.
sam: ops: any rollout impact? Do we rollback? :eyes:
maria: not yet customer visible, but oncall alerted. let's triage: 1) full profile diff 2) check KV key normalization path 3) run targeted workload with old/new kernels 4) add temporary fallback routing
chen: I'll run the targeted quantized-attn run and attach traces.
alex: attached trace link: https://perf.redwood/intake/1765433210
perf-bot: invocation results: kv_cache_misses increased for keys with trailing-null-pad. Evidence: key bytes differ: old vs new = extra 0x00 at offset 128.
maria: nice find. looks like attention tiling changed padding behavior, we need canonicalize trimming of trailing zeros before hashing.
sam: estimated fix = small change in prefix keying helper + unit test. Can we hotfix and roll canary?
alex: i'll prepare PR, tag eng-runtime@ and add rollout policy to fall back if hit-rate <= baseline-3%.
chen: also include test for mixed-quant kernel path.
maria: thanks. assign owners: alex (PR), chen (staging repro), sam (rollout). I'll monitor.
alex: thanks. will update here once PR is up. :thumbsup:
alex: PR up: https://github.com/redwoodinc/rti/pull/4321
maria: deploying canary 3 hosts now.
perf-bot: canary metrics: prefix_hit +4% on canary after PR, p99 first-token back to baseline.
sam: closing loop: plan to merge and ramp 50% tonight if stable.
